working_definition: Adult VNC cells of the authors' type hemilineages 5B/6B (Allen et al. 2020, Figure 1-source data 2), 5-day-old adults.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Secondary neuron belonging to a hemilineage that does not have active Notch signaling.

justification: The authors could not separate hemilineages 5B and 6B; both are Notch OFF hemilineages: their common class.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00049542 Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron (broad match).
